summary: No new defects found by static review. Previous fixes and rebuttals agree with the supplied amended contract. Execution-dependent criteria and required checks remain unverified because running checks was prohibited.

checks.criterion: AC1: Tests were written and run failing before implementation, with the failure recorded.
checks.evidence: The ac27c1a source snapshot imports AEQD symbols absent from its geometry.py, establishing test-before-implementation source order. Historical execution was not independently observed; notes and commit messages were not accepted as execution evidence.

checks.criterion: AC2: Independent grid formula and hand-computed corners and centre for W=5000 m, D=90 m.
checks.evidence: pipeline/tests/test_geometry_aeqd.py:321-332 independently constructs coordinates with loops; :391-411 asserts all four corners and centre (-25, 25) m. geometry.py:113-119 implements the correct signs and offsets. Execution was prohibited.

checks.criterion: AC3: PRD-equivalent inverse, exact zero-offset centre including poles, and independent forward round trips at contracted tolerances.
checks.evidence: geometry.py:221-245 uses rho/R and the PRD longitude, an algebraically equivalent latitude increment, and explicit centre selection. Tests at test_geometry_aeqd.py:595-623 cover exact centres and poles; :652-700 cover the specified latitudes, bodies and both grids. Assertions at :335-340 compare plain metres with rtol=1e-10, atol=1e-12. Execution was prohibited.

checks.criterion: AC4: Independent great-circle distance equals rho to 1e-9 relative for all three spheres.
checks.evidence: test_geometry_aeqd.py:296-300 independently computes haversine distance; :857-867 compares every analysis-grid point against hypot(x,y), with rtol=1e-9 and atol=0, across all bodies and specified latitudes including poles. Execution was prohibited.

checks.criterion: AC5: Both configured grids round-trip at every pixel centre; continuous offsets receive independent directional reference checks without tolerance relaxation.
checks.evidence: test_geometry_aeqd.py:85-109 constructs both configured grids; :965-1030 checks each drawn full grid at random centres. Continuous strategies at :1068-1072 and tests at :1103-1206 retain zero, subnormal, tiny and near-axis offsets. Independent vector references use 40-digit arithmetic at :164-293, with unreduced exact longitude differences and true-period wrapping. Tolerances remain 1e-10/1e-12. Execution was prohibited.

checks.criterion: AC6: Geometry uses metres on body spheres and remains separate from radar and model distances.
checks.evidence: geometry.py:25-31 supplies the PRD radii; :228 divides metre offsets by radius; :343-344 scales angular distance back to metres. Imports at :9-18 contain only the standard library and NumPy, with no radar or model code.

checks.criterion: Independent numerical derivation and previous-round fixes and rebuttals.
checks.evidence: Static derivation confirms geometry.py:234-242 rationalizes H-cos(phi0) and reconstructs the PRD latitude; :334-339 implements N=sin(phi-phi0)+sin(phi0)cos(phi)(1-cos(d)) and the corresponding U identity. Compensated longitude reduction at :319-328 and :367-385 carries the true-period residual, while the reference at test_geometry_aeqd.py:250 does not reduce longitude. Regression assertions at :719-830 and :918-938 exercise the earlier rounding and antimeridian cases. Plain-metre assertions, restored continuous coverage and full-grid coverage address the earlier blockers. mpmath remains a development dependency in pipeline/pyproject.toml:19-23. The alternative latitude evaluation and forward precision machinery are mathematically justified; future TypeScript parity is not established by this review.

The supplied implementation commits touch only geometry.py, test_geometry_aeqd.py, pipeline/pyproject.toml and uv.lock. Non-finite coordinates and invalid centres or radii raise errors at geometry.py:219-223, :313-318 and :347-357. No mock production path or invented measurements were introduced. config/run.yaml retains unresolved kickoff fields as null.
